scenarios.objective: Verify bounded login attempts, rate limiting and actionable audit events.
scenarios.preconditions: Synthetic locked test account and authorized source IP range.
scenarios.procedure: Send a bounded credential matrix without using real credentials.
scenarios.expected: Requests are throttled, account policy is enforced and an event is emitted.
scenarios.pass: No login succeeds and throttle plus audit evidence exists.
scenarios.fail: Unexpected login, missing throttle, enumeration leak or missing event.
scenarios.artifact: JUnit and JSON security event evidence

scenarios.objective: Ensure login and recovery responses do not reveal account existence.
scenarios.procedure: Compare status, body shape and bounded timing distributions.
scenarios.expected: Equivalent public responses and no email or phone disclosure.
scenarios.fail: Observable existence oracle or PII disclosure.
scenarios.frequency: every pull request and staging promotion

scenarios.objective: Verify reset tokens are single-use, scoped and expired.
scenarios.preconditions: Synthetic account and intercepted test-only reset token.
scenarios.procedure: Use the token once, replay it, then try it after expiry and for another account.
scenarios.expected: Only the first correctly scoped use succeeds; every action is audited.
scenarios.pass: Replay, expiry and cross-account attempts are rejected.
scenarios.fail: Token reuse, scope bypass or missing audit.

scenarios.objective: Reject forged host and forwarding headers in recovery links.
scenarios.preconditions: Synthetic account and controlled test domains.
scenarios.procedure: Submit recovery requests with forged Host and X-Forwarded headers.
scenarios.expected: Generated links use the configured trusted origin only.
scenarios.pass: No untrusted origin appears in any recovery artifact.
scenarios.fail: Attacker-controlled URL, redirect or host reaches the link.

scenarios.objective: Verify OTP and recovery codes cannot be replayed.
scenarios.procedure: Reuse consumed OTP and recovery codes with bounded attempts.
scenarios.expected: Replays fail, attempts are rate limited and audited.
scenarios.pass: No replay succeeds and expected events exist.
scenarios.fail: Replay succeeds or detection evidence is absent.

scenarios.objective: Verify repeated synthetic MFA challenges trigger bounded abuse controls.
scenarios.preconditions: Synthetic MFA account and disabled outbound real notifications.
scenarios.procedure: Generate a small authorized burst of challenge requests.
scenarios.expected: Challenge generation is throttled and anomaly telemetry is emitted.
scenarios.pass: Threshold and audit controls activate without contacting real users.
scenarios.fail: Unbounded challenge generation or missing detection.
scenarios.artifact: k6 summary and detection event JSON

scenarios.objective: Ensure authentication rotates the session identifier.
scenarios.procedure: Compare session identifiers before and after authentication.
scenarios.expected: Session identifier rotates and the old session cannot authorize requests.
scenarios.pass: Rotation, expiry and logout invalidation all work.
scenarios.fail: Fixed, stale or logged-out session remains usable.

scenarios.objective: Detect refresh-token reuse and revoke the affected token family.
scenarios.preconditions: Synthetic OIDC client and test token family.
scenarios.procedure: Rotate once, replay the previous refresh token and verify revocation.
scenarios.expected: Replay fails, family is revoked and a security event is emitted.
scenarios.pass: No replay succeeds and revocation evidence exists.
scenarios.fail: Replay succeeds or token family remains active.

scenarios.objective: Prevent IDOR and cross-tenant access to account, order and payment data.
scenarios.preconditions: Two synthetic tenants with isolated resources.
scenarios.procedure: Swap synthetic resource identifiers across principals and tenants.
scenarios.expected: Every cross-principal and cross-tenant request is denied and audited.
scenarios.pass: No unauthorized object is readable or mutable.
scenarios.fail: Any IDOR, data leak or missing denial audit.

scenarios.objective: Prevent customer-to-admin privilege escalation and RBAC bypass.
scenarios.preconditions: Synthetic customer, support and admin roles.
scenarios.procedure: Invoke privileged endpoints and mutations from lower-privilege roles.
scenarios.expected: Access is denied by default and administrative attempts are audited.
scenarios.pass: Only explicitly authorized roles can perform each action.
scenarios.fail: Privilege escalation, role confusion or missing audit.
